subjects.description: A red compact sedan and a black sedan ahead in the lanes, plus a few other cars further down the street, kept at their exact positions and sizes
subjects.appearance_details: Ordinary modern cars with wet, glossy paint and rain-streaked glass, tail lights reflecting on the wet asphalt
subjects.relationship: Traffic ahead of the recording vehicle

background_setting: A real city street in heavy rain and dense fog. Brick and stone buildings with shopfronts and awnings line both sides; the far end of the street fades into grey fog. Wet asphalt reflects the sky and the lights; a double yellow centre line, white dashed lane lines and solid white edge lines; concrete kerbs; street lamps and signs.

lighting.conditions: Heavy rain, dense fog, overcast daylight
lighting.shadows: None; soft reflections on the wet road

aesthetics.composition: Fixed camera rigidly mounted on a moving car; the road, kerb and buildings sweep past according to the camera's heading
aesthetics.color_palette: Grey fog, dark wet asphalt with bright reflections, muted brick facades, yellow and white road paint, red tail lights
aesthetics.mood: Wet, foggy, subdued city driving in the rain
aesthetics.visual_quality: Sharp, high-detail, natural photographic realism with no cartoon or rendered look

cinematography.camera_motion: Rigidly attached to a car moving forward at a steady speed
cinematography.camera_angle: Eye-level, mounted on the car body

context: Dashcam footage from a car driving at a steady speed along a city street in heavy rain and fog; raindrops streak the windshield and the road is wet. Preserve the camera viewpoint, the road geometry, the lane markings, the fog density and the position, size and motion of every vehicle exactly; do not add or remove vehicles, signs, poles or obstacles.

actions.description: The car drives forward at a constant speed; the street scene passes by smoothly in the direction the camera faces.

segments.description: Continuous dashcam view along a rainy, foggy city street behind two cars.

temporal_caption: Dashcam view moving steadily along a foggy, rain-soaked city street with brick buildings on both sides and cars ahead, visibility fading into grey fog.
audio_description: Ambient city traffic, tyre noise on asphalt, a low engine hum.
